copy.tagline: 快速了解 Trezor Suite 代码库结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Trezor Suite 仓库中寻找文件或决定代码放置位置。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand Trezor Suite codebase structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are navigating the Trezor Suite monorepo or deciding where to place new code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能告诉你 Trezor Suite 项目的目录结构，包括各个根目录和关键子目录的用途，比如 suite（Web/桌面）、suite-native（移动端）、suite-common（共享业务代码）和 packages（通用库）。
howto.when: 当你询问 Trezor Suite 代码结构，或需要决定新代码该放哪儿时触发。

say.text: Trezor Suite 的目录结构是怎么样的？
say.note: Claude 会列出主要目录及其功能。

say.text: 新代码应该放在 suite 还是 suite-common？
say.note: Claude 会解释两者区别并给出建议。

say.text: packages 目录下有哪些子包？
say.note: Claude 会列出如 connect、suite 等。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can describe the directory structure of the Trezor Suite monorepo, including root and key subdirectories like suite (Web/Desktop), suite-native (mobile), suite-common (shared business code), and packages (generic libs).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Trezor Suite code structure or need to decide where to place new code.

say_en.text: What is the directory structure of Trezor Suite?
say_en.note: Claude lists main directories and their purposes.

say_en.text: Should I put new code in suite or suite-common?
say_en.note: Claude explains differences and gives suggestions.
